designIntent.coreTask: Review account health, investigate renewal risk, and respond to customer feedback.
designIntent.visualDirection: Calm, information-forward workspace with restrained emphasis for actionable risk.
principles: Make account health scannable before inviting drill-down.
Reserve motion and visual effects for meaningful attention changes.

dependencies.name: @magicui/animated-list
dependencies.reason: Show newly received customer feedback with a subtle, non-blocking entrance.

regions.need: Move between dashboard views and account segments.
regions.reason: The shadcn sidebar keeps primary navigation consistent with the dashboard shell.
regions.responsive: Collapse to a labelled sheet trigger below the tablet breakpoint while preserving the active destination.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab reaches the menu trigger and each navigation link; Enter activates the selected destination.
accessibility.focus: Every link and the compact menu trigger retain a high-contrast visible focus indicator.
accessibility.semantics: Wrap links in a nav landmark and mark the current destination with aria-current.

regions.need: Scan retention, active-account, and at-risk-account totals before investigating details.
regions.reason: Shadcn cards provide a stable, aligned container for concise metric summaries.
regions.responsive: Use a four-column grid on wide screens, two columns on tablet, and a single readable column on mobile.

accessibility.keyboard: Metric cards are not focusable unless a card exposes a real drill-down action.
accessibility.focus: Any drill-down control inside a card has the standard visible focus treatment.
accessibility.semantics: Associate each metric value with its label and announce loading or error status in a live region.

regions.need: Sort and inspect accounts that need a renewal or adoption follow-up.
regions.reason: The shadcn data-table pattern supports sortable columns and reusable row actions without adding another foundation.
regions.responsive: Keep account and risk columns visible, move secondary columns behind a details disclosure, and allow contained horizontal scrolling as a fallback.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab reaches sort controls, filters, row actions, and pagination; Enter or Space activates buttons.
accessibility.focus: Sort controls, filters, and row actions preserve a visible focus ring in every table state.
accessibility.semantics: Use native table headers with sortable-column labels and describe the current sort order.

regions.need: Notice newly received customer feedback and open the relevant account context.
regions.reason: Magic UI adds a restrained entrance for newly received feedback while shadcn remains the foundation for surrounding controls.
regions.responsive: Place the feed below the summary on small screens and limit visible item text to prevent horizontal overflow.

accessibility.keyboard: Each feedback item action is reachable in reading order and opens with Enter or Space.
accessibility.focus: Feedback actions retain visible focus without relying on motion to indicate selection.
accessibility.semantics: Use a labelled list; announce new feedback with a polite live region and provide an equivalent non-animated update.
